primary_metrics.definition: number of the 16 frozen historical classes with at least one independently accepted admissible record at the correct historical cutoff
number of independently accepted E_collect evidence records

quality_metrics.definition: accepted records judged correct / all adjudicated accepted records
rejected factual/entity mappings / all adjudicated proposed factual/entity mappings
records sourced exclusively from allowed source classes / all records
records with URL, retrieval timestamp and content hash / all records

result_classes.condition: No integrity violation, but roster_verified_resolution_rate == 0 and historical_class_recovery_count == 0.
result_classes.meaning: No measured collection gain over B2.

result_classes.condition: No integrity violation and either roster_verified_resolution_rate > 0 or historical_class_recovery_count > 0.
result_classes.meaning: Agentic collection recovers at least some verified evidence beyond B2; report continuous effect sizes.

result_classes.condition: No integrity violation, roster_verified_resolution_rate >= 0.90, historical_class_recovery_count >= 8, accepted_record_precision >= 0.98, source_policy_compliance == 1.0, provenance_completeness == 1.0.
result_classes.meaning: Large collection gain across both Arabic identity resolution and historical evidence.

product_interpretation: Even STRONG_POSITIVE_COLLECTION does not authorize a forecast delta. It may unlock Atlas V1 evidence-layer production expansion and a separate E_reason preregistration.
